articles.description: Two weeks after the devastating flash floods, the number of dead and missing continues to rise. A race against time is underway: helping survivors, finding those still alive and identifying the victims. Rescue teams have been carrying out repeated helicopter flights,

articles.title: Israel says destroys Hezbollah tunnels as explosions triggers tremor

It comes a few days after Israeli authorities claimed to have taken control of the Ali al-Taher ridge, saying that the pro-Iranian Hezbollah had dug numerous tunnels there, allowing it to attack Israel from this mountainous area.

articles.title: China, Iran among countries using AI to spy on dissidents and minorities, Anthropic says
articles.description: Anthropic said Thursday it had disrupted several state-sponsored surveillance operations using its artificial intelligence models, warning of the growing AI use to target dissidents and minorities. The campaigns, detected between January and July, originated in China, Iran and West Africa and targeted diaspora communities, including Hong Kong pro-democracy activists.

articles.title: Vance calls Democrats 'party of hatred' as he seizes MAGA spotlight
articles.description: US Vice President JD Vance launched a virulent attack on the Democratic Party Thursday, accusing them of being the "party of hatred" at day two of the Republican convention ahead of the November midterm elections. With public support for President Donald Trump at record lows, Republican figures are increasingly trying to frame their opponents as dangerous political extremists.

articles.title: Iran : le prix des carburants s'envole
articles.description: L'économie s'effondre en Iran. Le pays est asphyxié par la guerre au Moyen-Orient et les sanctions économiques. Le régime a mis en place un système de rationnement, notamment pour l'essence, alors que 40 % de la population vit sous le seuil de pauvreté.

articles.title: J. D. Vance, en conclusion de la convention républicaine, passe sous silence la guerre en Iran et se pose en premier adversaire des démocrates

articles.title: Commémoration du 11 Septembre : «Nous n’oublierons jamais », « c’est pour ça que nous nous battons aujourd’hui », affirme Donald Trump

articles.title: Comment le handicap complique l’insertion professionnelle : « Les inégalités émergent dès la scolarité et se prolongent dans l’emploi »

In this special edition, we talk to Oleg Chirita, member of the Red Heads, the biggest international Celine Dion fan club in the world. Opposition lawmakers say such measures would amount to government censorship.

articles.description: Yemen’s Houthis seized the strategic Red Sea port city of Mocha on Thursday as their offensive against Saudi-backed government forces intensified. Saudi Arabia launched dozens of airstrikes over the past 24 hours, the Houthis said, after the Iran-backed group carried out attacks on Saudi territory that wounded dozens of people.

articles.title: Le site et l'application Pass Pass Mobilités victimes d'une cyberattaque dans les Hauts-de-France, 19 000 usagers concernés par un vol de données
articles.description: Le Syndicat mixte des mobilités des Hauts-de-France a saisi la CNIL et déposé plainte auprès des services de police chargés de la cybercriminalité.

articles.title: Hate speech against Rohingya refugees on the rise in Malaysia
articles.description: Hostile social media content, disinformation campaigns, and a petition calling for their expulsion: in Malaysia, a wave of hate speech has been targeting Rohingya refugees, a Muslim minority driven out of Myanmar. The rising hostility has already led to the eviction of more than 100 people from a village and forced the temporary closure of schools serving refugee children.
